stories.title: An AI Agent Injected Drugs Into a Live Mouse’s Brain
stories.explanation: A biotech startup successfully used an AI agent with a robotic arm to inject gene therapy into a live mouse's brain. This demonstrates a significant step towards AI agents becoming active participants in laboratory research and complex procedures.

stories.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
stories.explanation: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to allow website operators to communicate their AI training preferences to multiple participating providers. This voluntary effort aims to simplify content control for foundational generative AI training.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round
stories.explanation: OpenAI has reportedly lowered its funding target for a new round to $20 billion, with $11 billion secured so far, due to a 'tepid' response from some large investors. This indicates potential challenges in its fundraising efforts.

stories.title: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia
stories.explanation: Nvidia is reportedly considering guaranteeing billions in debt financing for Nscale’s planned Anthropic data center in West Virginia. This potential arrangement would help Nscale secure funding for the project, indicating Nvidia's commitment to supporting AI infrastructure buildout.

stories.title: Things That Go Beep in the Night: Agentic AI Joins the Search for Extraterrestrial Signals
stories.explanation: Scientists at the Allen Telescope Array are using NVIDIA Holoscan to integrate agentic AI into the search for extraterrestrial signals. This allows AI agents to steer instruments, enhance data, and apply AI models to sensor data streams, advancing SETI research.

stories.title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward
stories.explanation: A federal judge allowed an NAACP lawsuit against xAI to proceed, accusing the company of violating the Clean Air Act by operating gas turbines without necessary permits. This legal development impacts xAI's data center operations and environmental compliance.

stories.title: Spooky New Infostealer Malware Uses AI to ‘Autodox’ Victims
stories.explanation: New malware called 'Volta-Autodoxer' uses AI functionality to automatically profile victims and extract high-value data. This highlights the evolving threat landscape where commercial LLMs are being integrated into infostealer malware.

stories.title: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
stories.explanation: Apple will launch Apple Intelligence in China with an iOS 27.3 beta next week, with a full release in December. This expands the availability of Apple's AI features to a major market.

stories.title: Chatbots Are Leading Hikers Astray, With Dangerous Consequences
stories.explanation: Hikers were led astray by Google's AI chatbot Gemini, resulting in a dangerous situation on Mount Shasta. This highlights the potential risks of over-reliance on AI for critical planning, especially in safety-sensitive contexts.

stories.title: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could
stories.explanation: A user built an AI Tamagotchi-like gadget using off-the-shelf hardware, similar to Meta's upcoming Muse Charm. This demonstrates the accessibility of creating personal AI companions with existing technology.
